questions.question_text: Which storage redundancy type should you choose to ensure data is replicated to a secondary region in case of a regional outage?
questions.explanation: Geo-redundant storage (GRS) replicates your data to a secondary region, providing durability in case of a regional outage. Reference: [Azure Storage redundancy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-redundancy).

questions.question_text: You need to allow secure transfer of data to your Azure Storage account. Which setting should you configure?
questions.explanation: Enabling HTTPS only ensures that data is securely transferred to and from your storage account. Reference: [Azure Storage account overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-account-overview).

questions.question_text: Which tool can you use to upload data to Azure Blob Storage from the command line?
questions.explanation: AzCopy is a command-line utility designed to efficiently transfer data to and from Azure Blob Storage. Reference: [AzCopy overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-use-azcopy-v10).

questions.question_text: What is the primary benefit of enabling object replication across Azure Storage accounts?
questions.explanation: Object replication enables data consistency by automatically replicating objects across different storage accounts in different regions. Reference: [Object replication overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/object-replication-overview).

questions.question_text: If you want to encrypt data at rest in your Azure Storage account using your own keys, which encryption option should you select?
questions.explanation: Customer-managed keys (CMK) allow you to control encryption keys used to protect your data, providing greater control over your encryption settings. Reference: [Azure Storage encryption for data at rest](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-service-encryption).

questions.question_text: How can you monitor the access patterns and performance of your Azure Storage account?
questions.explanation: Azure Monitor provides comprehensive monitoring of Azure services, including access patterns and performance metrics for storage accounts. Reference: [Azure Monitor overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/overview).

questions.question_text: Which feature allows you to configure access to a storage account using private endpoints?
questions.explanation: Azure Private Link allows you to access Azure services, like Storage accounts, over a private endpoint in your virtual network. Reference: [Azure Private Link for Azure Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-private-endpoints).

questions.question_text: Which Azure tool provides a graphical interface for managing storage accounts and their contents?
questions.explanation: Azure Storage Explorer is a standalone app that allows you to manage your storage accounts and their contents using a graphical interface. Reference: [Azure Storage Explorer](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-explorer).
